searchText: I'm having some issues with the EF prater nodes, giving them some love and care now. That should bring back participation rates on prater. EF nodes should be healthy again, I'll monitor for a bit but I already see fewer missed proposals + participation increasing. Sailed quite close to 1/3 of validators down there, may be worth spreading them around a bit more so that there is less chance of lack of finality with a single set of validators down. Agreed, I'll work on that and getting better monitoring up this week. Is there something going on with the EF nodes on Prater? they are a bunch loosing ETH and missing sporadically attestations for the last 4 days Pyrmont is struggling and we are getting alerts. Is this intentional testing or teams turning down their nodes without exiting? Most of the EF nodes should be healthy now, i think 1-2 are still getting there (probably 2000-3000 keys, so ~1% of prater). We still seem to be missing like 8% compared to yesterday, is someone else having issues too? it seems someone turned all of their stuff off a few days ago talking about pyrmont we didn't outline a sunset plan so i suppose we are just turning it down pyrmont finalizing now Yeah I've seen pyrmont bouncing around in participation a fair bit. All our validators are running but scheduled to exit (you Prysm folk got into the queue first so we'll be waiting a while). As more of our validators exit a greater percentage of the network will be unmaintained nodes so it will stop finalizing eventually but that doesn't explain these sudden drops. We've also been moving our Pyrmont validators to new infrastructure, that's a potential reason for issues. However, that big drop was the middle of the night for us so it's unlikely we had validators intentionally down then.
